source_authority.incident_summary: cliEval telemetry parsed agent output with text-regex instead of the structured stream-json event stream, producing PARTIAL->PASS promotion, files_changed=0, empty last_task_id, and phase-name leading-dash artifacts.

reason: Telemetry text-regex-vs-stream-json is a sprint/eval-harness concern (A6 cross-cuts A1a/A11), not a roadmap-pipeline scanner. No roadmap pipeline component consumes a fixture to reproduce it, so no verifiable expected values are constructible.
